target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Established butcher-inspired steakhouse in Ashtabula Harbor. Could benefit from online ordering, reservation system, and local producer marketplace features. Primary namesake for this MVP - strong local recognition in Ashtabula Harbor area.

target_buyer_2.type: Local Food Market / Demonstration Kitchen / Nonprofit
target_buyer_2.owner: T Gallo - Nurse Practitioner and Owner
target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Community-focused food market and demonstration kitchen in Ashtabula Harbor. Mission: 'A general store building community around self-reliance and food security, appreciation for our local ecosystems and sell items sustainably grown and made in Ashtabula County.' Over 50 local vendors (many in Ashtabula County). Products: Local produce, grains, beans, cheeses from Mayfield Creamery, sourdough breads, handmade items by local artists, books by local authors, maple syrup, honey, eggs, soaps, local artisans. Offers classes (cooking, canning, fermenting), urban food forest tours. Publishes 'Homegrown: Spotlight on Local Food' column in North Coast Voice. An online marketplace with producer profiles would expand their reach significantly.

rennick_meat_market.fit_for_mvp: Online ordering, reservation system, local producer marketplace
rennick_meat_market.note: Primary namesake for this MVP - strong local recognition
